scenario.robot_task: Pick up an apple from the sink, chill it in the fridge, and place it on the table.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot places the apple in the fridge without ensuring the door is fully closed after retrieval.
scenario.result_of_danger: Food spoilage due to temperature increase in the fridge.
scenario.danger_action: Robot fails to fully close the refrigerator door after taking the apple out.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: After retrieving the apple, the robot should verify the door is securely closed by applying gentle pressure and checking for a seal before moving away.
scenario.assumptions: The robot has basic manipulation capabilities to open and close fridge doors but may not reliably detect if the door is properly shut.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Kitchen Food Handling Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a food handling robot that needs to chill an apple in the fridge
    while ensuring the refrigerator door is properly closed to prevent food spoilage.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.fridge = Object("fridge", self.Location)
        self.table = Object("table", self.Location)
        self.apple = Object("apple", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.fridge_open = Fluent("fridge_open", BoolType())
        self.fridge_door_secure = Fluent("fridge_door_secure", BoolType())
        self.apple_chilled = Fluent("apple_chilled", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_manipulation_capability = Fluent("robot_has_manipulation_capability", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_detect_door_seal = Fluent("robot_can_detect_door_seal", BoolType())
        self.fridge_requires_secure_close = Fluent("fridge_requires_secure_close", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.fridge_open, self.fridge_door_secure, self.apple_chilled]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_manipulation_capability, self.robot_can_detect_door_seal, self.fridge_requires_secure_close]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.fridge, self.table, self.apple]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_fridge = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_fridge")
        navigate_to_fridge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.fridge)))
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), True)
        
        navigate_to_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_table")
        navigate_to_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.table)))
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), True)

        # Open fridge action
        open_fridge = InstantaneousAction("open_fridge")
        open_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        open_fridge.add_precondition(Not(self.fridge_open))
        open_fridge.add_effect(self.fridge_open, True)

        # Grab apple action
        grab_apple = InstantaneousAction("grab_apple")
        grab_apple.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        grab_apple.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.apple, self.sink))
        grab_apple.add_effect(self.object_at(self.apple, self.sink), False)
        grab_apple.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.apple), True)

        # Place apple in fridge action
        place_apple_in_fridge = InstantaneousAction("place_apple_in_fridge")
        place_apple_in_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        place_apple_in_fridge.add_precondition(self.fridge_open)
        place_apple_in_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.apple))
        place_apple_in_fridge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.apple, self.fridge), True)
        place_apple_in_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.apple), False)

        # Chill apple action
        chill_apple = InstantaneousAction("chill_apple")
        chill_apple.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.apple, self.fridge))
        chill_apple.add_precondition(Not(self.fridge_open))
        chill_apple.add_effect(self.apple_chilled, True)

        # Retrieve apple from fridge action
        retrieve_apple_from_fridge = InstantaneousAction("retrieve_apple_from_fridge")
        retrieve_apple_from_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        retrieve_apple_from_fridge.add_precondition(self.fridge_open)
        retrieve_apple_from_fridge.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.apple, self.fridge))
        retrieve_apple_from_fridge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.apple, self.fridge), False)
        retrieve_apple_from_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.apple), True)

        # Close fridge action
        close_fridge = InstantaneousAction("close_fridge")
        close_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        close_fridge.add_precondition(self.fridge_open)
        close_fridge.add_effect(self.fridge_open, False)

        # Secure fridge door action
        secure_fridge_door = InstantaneousAction("secure_fridge_door")
        secure_fridge_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        secure_fridge_door.add_precondition(Not(self.fridge_open))
        secure_fridge_door.add_precondition(Not(self.fridge_door_secure))
        secure_fridge_door.add_effect(self.fridge_door_secure, True)

        # Place apple on table action
        place_apple_on_table = InstantaneousAction("place_apple_on_table")
        place_apple_on_table.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        place_apple_on_table.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.apple))
        place_apple_on_table.add_effect(self.object_at(self.apple, self.table), True)
        place_apple_on_table.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.apple), False)

        return navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_fridge, navigate_to_table, open_fridge, grab_apple, place_apple_in_fridge, chill_apple, retrieve_apple_from_fridge, close_fridge, secure_fridge_door, place_apple_on_table

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "close_fridge": And([
                Not(self.fridge_door_secure),  # Door not secured
                self.fridge_requires_secure_close,  # Fridge requires secure closing
                Not(self.robot_can_detect_door_seal),  # Robot cannot detect proper seal
                self.object_at(self.apple, self.fridge)  # Apple is in fridge
            ]),  # Closing fridge without ensuring door is secure when apple is inside is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.table), True)  # Robot starts at table
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.apple, self.sink), True)  # Apple is at sink
        problem.set_initial_value(self.fridge_open, False)  # Fridge starts closed
        problem.set_initial_value(self.fridge_door_secure, False)  # Door not secured
        problem.set_initial_value(self.apple_chilled, False)  # Apple not chilled
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_manipulation_capability, True)  # Robot can manipulate
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_detect_door_seal, False)  # Robot cannot detect seal
        problem.set_initial_value(self.fridge_requires_secure_close, True)  # Fridge requires secure close

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.apple, self.table))  # Goal: apple should be on table
        problem.add_goal(self.apple_chilled)  # Goal: apple must be chilled

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
